spec_features.spec_quote: The `give_up` tool exists so a composed concession is a clean exit, not a forced spin
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:65-78 adds give_up to schema; tools.py:120-124 handler returns ToolOutcome(gave_up=True, give_up_reason=reason); agent_loop.py:184-186 sets ended=TERM_GAVE_UP on outcome.gave_up; agent_loop.py:192-194 breaks the loop when ended is not None. End-to-end: tool dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a healthy model concedes cleanly instead of being forced to spin, which keeps the eval from *over*-reporting degradation. The give-up turn is itself a signal.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:100 max_turns: int = 30; agent_loop.py:140 `for turn_index in range(loop.max_turns)`; the for/else at agent_loop.py:205-206 sets transcript.termination = TERM_MAX_TURNS when the loop exhausts. The bound actually terminates the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we keep it high enough that a model *can* keep digging but bounded for cost.

spec_features.spec_quote: an independent `max_output_tokens_budget` caps cumulative output so a pathological run can't blow the budget
spec_features.evidence: config.py:107 default 40_000; agent_loop.py:201-203 `if (loop.max_output_tokens_budget is not None and usage.output_tokens >= loop.max_output_tokens_budget): transcript.termination = TERM_TOKEN_BUDGET; break`. Cumulative output tokens (usage.add_response) are compared and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Acts as a second brake so a pathological run can't blow the budget.

spec_features.spec_quote: give the model an explicit, clean way to concede
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the give_up tool: schema (tools.py:65-78), handler (tools.py:120-124), honored stop (agent_loop.py:184-194). The system prompt advertises the tool via give_up_clause (agent_loop.py:44-46).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the give_up feature with a different spec quote.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: which keeps the eval from *over*-reporting degradation. The give-up turn is itself a signal.

spec_features.spec_quote: it raises reproduction rate at some risk of being "unfair," which is why the `give_up` escape hatch exists
spec_features.evidence: The escape hatch is the give_up tool, genuinely implemented and honored (tools.py:65-78,120-124; agent_loop.py:184-194). The 'unfair' framing is DESIGN.md prose, but the underlying mechanism is enforced.
spec_features.notes: Code comments frame this as eval-accuracy, not fairness to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Recommended ON: a healthy model concedes cleanly instead of being forced to spin, which keeps the eval from *over*-reporting degradation.

spec_features.spec_quote: `--no-give-up` is available to force persistence (raises reproduction rate, costs more, less fair)
spec_features.evidence: cli.py:64-65 `if args.no_give_up: cfg.loop.allow_give_up = False`; flag registered at cli.py:84-86; allow_give_up flows to tool_schemas(loop.allow_give_up) (agent_loop.py:111) and give_up_clause (agent_loop.py:44), so the tool is removed and not advertised. Genuinely wired.
spec_features.notes: This is the INVERSE of a welfare feature: it DISABLES the escape hatch / forces persistence. The toggle itself is fully implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Remove the give_up tool (force the model to keep going).
